## Description

Hand-made HTML mockups of every view, one self-contained file each under docs/mockups/, depicting this project. HTML is the interactive medium: a page that a local daemon serves from the checked-out repository, with progressive disclosure per role. A mockup shows its disclosure levels, for example with details elements, and needs no server. The defined gate agrees what the view shows in HTML; the mockup gate delivers the file; later gates belong to the tableaud subproject.

References:

- [The mockups](docs/mockups)
